corporate.description: We help businesses navigate complex legal and commercial matters with clear, strategic, and commercially focused advice. From business formation to day-to-day contracts and major transactions, our team supports companies at every stage of growth.

aboutSection.description:
Our Corporate & Commercial practice provides end-to-end legal support to startups, growing businesses, established enterprises, investors, and corporate groups.

We combine legal expertise with a practical understanding of business objectives, helping clients manage risk, maintain compliance, structure transactions, and make confident commercial decisions.

items.description: Advice on selecting and establishing the right business structure, including incorporation, shareholder arrangements, joint ventures, partnerships, and corporate reorganisations.

items.title: Corporate Governance

aboutSection.description:
Our Real Estate practice offers unmatched expertise in property law. We help clients through every step of acquiring, developing, leasing, and selling properties.

From negotiating complex commercial leases to resolving boundary disputes, our team provides strategic counsel designed to maximize the value of your real estate assets.

content.title: New Child Custody Guidelines in Bangladesh: What You Need to Know
content.description: The recent amendments to child custody laws aim to prioritize the best interests of the child. Here's what parents need to know about the new guidelines.
content.author: By Ayesha Rahman
content.body: Child custody matters can be emotionally challenging for everyone involved. To ensure that the best interests of the child remain the top priority, Bangladesh has introduced updated guidelines that bring more clarity and fairness to custody decisions.

sections.title: What Has Changed?
sections.description: The new guidelines emphasize the child's well-being above all else. Courts will now evaluate factors such as the child's emotional needs, stability, education, and the ability of each parent to provide a nurturing environment.

bullets.label: Child's Best Interests
bullets.text: The primary consideration in all custody decisions.

bullets.label: Parental Involvement
bullets.text: Encouraging both parents to remain actively involved.

bullets.label: Living Conditions
bullets.text: Assessing the quality and stability of each parent's home.

bullets.label: Child's Preference
bullets.text: For older children, their preferences may be considered.

sections.title: Joint Custody Encouraged
sections.description: Where possible, the courts now encourage joint custody arrangements to ensure children maintain strong relationships with both parents.

sections.title: How This Impacts Parents
sections.description: These updates aim to reduce conflicts and promote cooperative parenting. It's important for parents to understand their rights and responsibilities under the new guidelines and seek legal advice to navigate the process smoothly.

key-changes-company-law-2025.description: An overview of the significant amendments and their impact on businesses and compliance.

heroImage.alt: Key Changes in Company Law You Should Know in 2025

content.heading: Introduction
content.text: The year 2025 brings several important amendments to the regulatory frameworks aimed at enhancing transparency, strengthening corporate governance, and promoting ease of doing business. These changes are expected to have a significant impact on companies, directors, and other stakeholders.

content.heading: 1. Enhanced Corporate Governance
content.text: The new amendments emphasize greater accountability of directors and key managerial personnel. Stricter disclosure norms and enhanced responsibilities will ensure more transparent decision-making and protect stakeholder interests.

content.heading: 2. Simplified Compliance Requirements
content.text: Several compliance processes have been simplified through digital integration and a risk-based approach. This move is expected to reduce the compliance burden on businesses, especially for startups and small companies.

content.heading: 3. Strengthened Shareholder Rights
content.text: Shareholder empowerment remains at the core of the 2025 amendments. Provisions related to e-voting, related party transactions, and minority shareholder protection have been further strengthened.

content.heading: 4. Focus on Sustainability and ESG
content.text: The law now places greater emphasis on Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) practices. Certain classes of companies will be required to disclose sustainability-related information in their annual reports.

content.heading: Conclusion
content.text: These changes reflect the government's continued focus on building a transparent, accountable, and globally competitive corporate environment. Businesses should stay informed and adapt to these updates to remain compliant and future-ready.
